notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018502/591bef396e7535f2f8045ec28b4b5d07c019f10e.jpg

Added a point info in the Game Paused screen (right click/esc button prompt) Also should fix some funky point error some experience, but tbh not totally sure either. Hopefully it does for those who experience it. If the points still go over 100 or under 0, please let me know. If any save issue occurs after the update also please let me know (email me at ceylonent.ind@gmail.com for quickest reply) and sorry for the inconvenience!
